policy.humanOffline: No automatic AI takeover, spending or surrender. Wait at human decision; retain active game indefinitely.
policy.presence: 15-second lease. During unannounced network loss the clock may continue until lease expiry; explicit disconnect or process restart clears presence immediately.
policy.time: Server shutdown/restart does not catch up downtime. Other users cannot restart an offline human minigame clock.
policy.pendingMissing: Never auto-execute. Only explicit retry sends the original immutable intent.
policy.capacity: 32 active games is an admission limit, not a tested throughput claim. Finished games remain readable. No automatic deletion.
policy.pause: Shared pause remains unavailable; menus do not freeze global play.
